subject: Fwd: On-prem adapter delay — request for short sandbox runway
messages:
From: Alex Tanner <alex@cloudfurnace.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: On-prem adapter delay — request for short sandbox runway

Hey Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We made good progress but hit a blocker while trying to finish the on-prem adapter integration: our environment uses an older libc variant that causes the adapter to crash under specific I/O patterns. Engineering estimates a fix + validation will take ~10 business days because we need to run through our internal security testing and a full regression on our staging infra.

We are mid-trial and will likely exhaust the tokens we planned to use before the adapter is stable. Can Redwood provide a short sandbox top-up and extend our trial window by two weeks so we can finish the integration and run the full validation?

I attached a short log snippet that reproduces the crash for your SEs to look at. If you need anything else from our side (stack traces, config diffs), I can have our ops lead attach them.

Desired: +2 weeks trial extension and a sandbox top-up to cover our remaining test runs (~500k tokens).

Appreciate any help — we really like the performance but this on-prem integration is gating the rollout.

— Alex
Alex Tanner
Director of Engineering, CloudFurnace
ops@cloudfurnace.com
[Attachment: onprem-integration-log-aug03.txt (text)]
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: On-prem adapter delay — request for short sandbox runway

Team — forwarding CloudFurnace's note. TL;DR: on-prem adapter compatibility issue, asks for a 2-week trial extension + ~500k token sandbox top-up to finish validation. They provided a log.

Why this matters: this is a mid-market prospect with clear on-prem requirements; if we give a short runway they can finish validation and progress to a Dedicated conversation. Risk is small if we limit credits/timebox.

Ask: can we approve a 2-week extension + $1k equivalent sandbox credit (approx. 500k tokens) and send a confirmation with a short checklist for their final validation? CSM / SE please own the follow-up cadence.

Notes: they are running an older libc variant — Vivek, can you take a look at the log and confirm this is an adapter compatibility issue and whether a local patch will be simple to validate?

I need a quick thumbs-up so I can reply to Alex today.

Thanks — Priya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Forwarded message attached]
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Fwd: On-prem adapter delay — request for short sandbox runway

Priya — approved.

Let's do a narrow, conditional concession: grant a 2-week trial extension and a $1,000 sandbox credit (one-time top-up). Conditions:
- Credit expires at the end of the 2-week extension period.
- CSM (Monica) to schedule a 30-min technical checkpoint in 7 calendar days to ensure progress.
- If we see activity indicating they won't complete validation, credit will be revoked.

Monica — please create the sandbox top-up record and confirm the expiration timestamp in HubSpot. Priya — you can send confirmation to Alex with the promo code RF-EXT-0826 and the checklist below.

Quick checklist to send:
1) Reproduce crash with provided log + attach full stack trace if possible.
2) Patch or workaround validated on their staging infra.
3) Security scan rerun and pass.
4) Final smoke test against their on-prem staging (2-3 sample requests).
